'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Chris Schoenthal LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Schoenthal]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' This Deck Is the Worst Because It's "The Most Boringest One"
* '''Username:''' imrahil1327
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
